title: Common Location Remarks
html:
This page is in the process of being constructed or reformatted. You are welcome to contribute as well.
Last edited on 2025-10-05. If multiple days have passed since, this template should be removed.

These are location remarks and voicebarks which are used by Custom origin (Tav) or common for any Origin (including the  Dark Urge), if they do not have their own unique comment for particular situation. Most are played only once, and might be performed by any party member, whomever triggers them first. In some party combinations, a particular party member has the priority to voice their line, even if it is common for all of them.

In case of specific conditions (like Race, Class or Subclass), these are recorded separately.

When performed by Origin characters, common location remarks are voiced by the corresponding voice actors.

Prologue

Nursery and Surgery

  • (Climbed out from the Mind Flayer Pod): “Ngh. My head...”
    • (In Multiplayer, responding remark 1): “Wherever we are, it's falling apart”
    • (In Multiplayer, responding remark 2): “I hear fighting. Trouble's not over yet.”
    • (In Multiplayer, responding remark 3): “We need a way out. Now.”
  • (Interacted with their own pod): “Not getting back in that thing.”
    • (Interacted with their own pod, 2): “Might still be stuck inside if we hadn't been attacked.”
    •  Githyanki character: “Ghaik prison.”
    •  Githyanki character (2): “I am free. Never to be captured again.”
  • (Interacted with any other intact pod in the room): “Someone else got out.”
    • (Other intact pod, 2): “Might be other survivors.”
    • (Other intact pod, 3): “Wonder who was inside...”
    • (Other intact pod, 4): “Made it out.”
  • (Interacted with any other ruptured pod in the room): “Not everyone made it out alive.”
    • (Other ruptured pod, 2): “Lucky I made it out.”
    • (Other ruptured pod, 3): “Burnt to a crisp.”
  • (Looked out from the hull breach): “Where the hells are we?”
    • (Hull breach, 2): “One of the Nine Hells.”
  • (Looted a dead Mind Flayer): “Dead. Good.”
  • (Used the Restoration pod): “Odd. I feel... better.”
  • (After the first fight with Lesser Imps): “What's next?” (Only if Lae'zel or Losiir [1] are not in the party, otherwise their line will be played)
  • (Saw a dragon on the way to upper deck): “The ship won't be able to take another dragon attack. We need to get out before it's too late.”
  • (Interacting with the Tentacle Aquarium for the first time): “Brains?”
    • (After the first time): “Nothing but brains. Food for mind flayers, I suppose.”
  • (Interacting with Cerebral Aquarium for the first time): “Mind flayer horticulture.”
    • (After the first time): “Odd things. Wonder what plane they're from.”

Ceremorphosis Chamber

  • (Upon entering the chamber, saw the control panel): “Mind flayer machinery. Better watch what I touch.”
  • (Failed  Arcana checks while reading the control sigils):
    • (Central sigil): “Can't read this script.”
    • (Left sigil): “Another mystery.”
    • (Right sigil): “Hm.”
  • (Used ‘Unleash’ button): “Already dead.”
  • (Used ‘Aggression’ button): “Machine made them hostile.”
  • (Try to open the Elaborate Reliquary without a key): “Needs a key.”
    • (Found the key): “A key - for what?”
    • (Found the key, already tried to open the chest): “Might fit that chest.”
  • (Found a socket in Shadowheart’s pod): “Whatever fits in that socket must power this thing.” (Will be available only if the player (or no one of the players) hasn't chosen Shadowheart as an origin character)
    • (Found the Eldritch Rune): “This might unlock those controls next to the pod.”
    • (Found the Eldritch Rune, hasn’t spoken to Shadowheart): “A rune. But for what?”
  • (Saw dozens of pods in the Transformation room): “How many are there?” (Played only if Lae'zel hasn't entered the room with the character, otherwise her line will be played)
  • (Sat in one of the chairs surrounding the pod in Transformation room): “Voices.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “I don't hear anything.”
    • (In Multiplayer, responding remark 2): “It must be the chair, connecting to ship. And its mind flayers.”
    • (In Multiplayer, responding remark 3): “Let's go before they realise we're out of our pods.”
  • (Trying to read the button in Transformation room,  Arcana failed): “Could mean anything.”
  • (Saw the woman in the pod transformed): “We need to get out of here - before it's our turn.”
    •  Dwarven character: “Moradin's bloody beard... I'm not waiting around for that to happen to us.”[2]
    •  Drow character,  Drow Half-Elven character: “Straj! Is this to be our fate?”
    •  Duergar character: “Disgusting. I'll be damned if that's in store for us.”
    •  High Elven character,  High Half-Elven character: “Corellon preserve me. That cannot be our fate.”
    •  Githyanki character: “Tsk'va! This cannot - must not - be our fate.”
  • (Picked up either Slave Mind or Dark Mind): “A brain in a jar...”
    • (Picked up the second one of these two): “Another brain.”

The Helm

  • (In Multiplayer, if another character has entered the Helm, while the player character hasn’t yet): “Ship's going to buckle. I need to get to the helm.”
  • (On the third turn of the fight in the Helm): “We need to get out of here - now.”
  • (On the fifth turn of the fight in the Helm): “If this ship hits the ground, we're dead!”
  • (Mind Flayer turns on the party after killing Commander Zhalk): “That thing's focused on us now! Let's get to the transponder and get out of here.”
  • (Mind Flayer died in the fight with cambions): “Mind flayer's dead - the imps killed it.”
  • (Mind Flayer and cambions dead, player character reminds themselves of the transponder): “Damn these imps - I need to reach the transponder.”
  • (Interacting with Nautiloid Tank 1): “Some kind of tank?”
    • (Nautiloid Tank, 2): “Odd.”
    • (Nautiloid Tank, 3): “More of the same.”
    • (Nautiloid Tank, 4): “More where this came from.”

Act One

Ravaged Beach and Roadside Cliffs

  • (Near the docks): "Fresh water. There must be a settlement somewhere nearby."
    • (Responding remark): “Let's hope the locals are friendly.”
  • (Saw Losiir's dead body): “The githyanki from the mind flayer ship. A shame he didn't survive.”
  • (Noticed the survived Intellect Devourers): “More of those wretched things.”
    •  Githyanki character : “More of the mind flayers' pets.”
  • (Encountering Intellect Devourers in the Nautiloid Wreck): "Better stay back. One strike could be lethal."
  • (Approaching the wounded mind flayer in the Nautiloid Wreck): "There! A mind flayer - and it's hurt."
    • (Responding remark): “Even injured, it's dangerous. Be careful.”
    •  Githyanki character (Responding remark): “Even injured, a ghaik can kill. Proceed with caution.”
    •  Duergar character (Responding remark): “Hurt, but still kicking - I can feel it scrabbling from here. Watch yourself.”
  • (After killing the wounded mind flayer): “Monster. Death is too good for it.”
    •  Githyanki character: “Ghaik. Death is too kind a fate.”
    • (Killed mind flayer after it tried to subdue the character): “For the best. Death is too good for it.”
    •  Githyanki character: “For the best. The ghaik earned its fate.”
  • (Noticed footprints leading from the crash site): “Footprints. There may be even more that survived the crash.”
  • (Approaching unstable rune - the point of Gale’s recruitment): “What's going on with that rune? Looks unstable somehow.”
  • (Noticed a movable rock under the cliff X: 143 Y: 281,  Nature check):
    • (Successful): “Deep grooves in the mud around that rock.”
    • (Failed): “Nice view.”
  • (Found a broken trap near the road): “Not much use anymore.”
  • (Respond to Lae'zel, who found a broken trap 1): “And yet another. Hardly the warmest of welcomes.”
    • (Respond to Lae'zel 2): “Broken. Must have been here a while.”
    • (Respond to Lae'zel 3): “Are they all like this?”
    • (Respond to Lae'zel 4): “Another broken trap. Who made these things?”

Overgrown Ruins and the Dank Crypt

  • (Found a cracked hole in the floor slabs): There's something underneath here...
  • (Noticed the marble block hanging from a crane): Wouldn't take much to send that stone crashing downwards...
  • (Trying to read an old bronze plaque near the statue outside the chapel, a  Paladin character or a  Cleric character): “Text is too faded. Doesn't tell me who was worshipped here.”
  • (Entering the Refectory (solo walkthrough), a  Paladin character): "I sense another undead presence here. Powerful, but not malevolent."
  • (Trying to read an old bronze plaque on the wall inside the Refectory): "A dead tongue. Whoever worshipped here must be long gone."
    • (Reading bronze plaque, a  Paladin character or a  Cleric character): “This text is ancient. A dedication to a forgotten god?”
  • (Tried to open the door between the Refectory and the Dank Crypt): "No lock, no handle. How does it open?" (Plays when moving in any direction)
  • (Entering the crypt from the chapel): "No more prayers, only dust and silence."
  • (Finding the skeletons) "Armed scribes - but no sign of a struggle."
    • (Responding remark): “I wonder what was so subversive about their words that they commanded protection.”
  • (After skeletons have been defeated): “They didn't want to surrender their valuables, even after death.”
    • (Responding remark): “Relics are wasted on bones. We can make much better use of them.”
  • (Sneaked past enlivened skeletons): “I pity anyone caught by those things. We were lucky to get out with the loot.”
    • (Responding remark): “Relics are wasted on bones. We can make much better use of them.”
  • (Ran away, escaped from the crypt): “A lucky escape. Judging by how they fought, those things weren't happy with our looting.”
  • (Trying to read an old bronze plaque in the feet of the statue in the crypt, a  Paladin character or a  Cleric character): “I've never seen this language before. Who was worshipped here?”
  • (Found Book of Dead Gods): "Looks like someone wanted to bury their secrets."
    • A  Wizard character or a  Warlock character): "Forbidden knowledge - without a doubt."
    • A  Cleric character): "That's locked for a reason. Let's not disturb it."
    • An Evil  Cleric character): "Locked to keep the evil in, or the prying eyes out? Let's see."
    • A  Rogue character): "Now that's a lock that screams 'pick me'."
  • (Found a Soul Coin): "A strange coin. I wonder what it's worth."
  • (Activating the button near Withers's room): "Hells... something just woke up down here."
  • (Entering the room with Withers's sarcophagus): "A lot of effort to hide one sarcophagus."
  • (Entering the locked part of the crypt) "This place wasn't built for the living."
    • (A  Wizard character): “This whole place reeks of necromancy.”
    • (A  Cleric character): “Something divine lingers here - but I don't recognise this presence.”
  • (Trying to read an old bronze plaque near the tomb in the crypt, a  Paladin character or a  Cleric character): “A dead language? Something ancient must have been worshipped here.”

* (Saw a gas pit trap in the crypt): “I can't see any way to disarm it.”

  • (Trying to press a button that deactivates an avoided-so-far trap): “Hmm. It won't move.”
  • (Found a necklace at Harpers’ outpost,  History check): “Necklace has a Harper sigil. Why were they here?”
    • (Found a necklace at Harpers’ outpost,  Githyanki character): “A sigil of the Harpers. Odd for their kind to misplace this.”
    • (Failed): “Odd necklace. Might sell for a few coppers.”
    • (Failed,  Githyanki character): “Hideous trinket. Lacking in function or taste.”
    • (Read Harper's Notebook from under the rock): “Necklace matches the sigil in that cave. The Harpers were busy.”
    • (Read Harper's Notebook,  Githyanki character): “This necklace's sigil was also in the cave. The Harpers have been unusually active here.”
  • (Successfully convinced the looters from Abandoned Chapel to flee): “Lucky those bandits valued their own hides over their loot.”
  • (Responding remark): “Good work. Thought we had a fight on our hands.”


Emerald Grove

The Hollow

  • (Approaching the grove for the first time): “I hear shouting up ahead.”
    • (Responding remark): “We should check it out - but be careful.”
  • (After defeating first pack of goblins): “It's done - good.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “Was that an ordinary raid? Seemed a fool's errand.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “They likely have a camp nearby. I'd expect more raiders eventually.”
  • (Aradin was knocked out by Zevlor): “Oof - I bet he broke his nose. Friendly place.”
  • (Zevlor was knocked out by Aradin): “Oof - I bet he broke that tiefling's nose. Friendly place.”
  • (Zevlor was knocked out by Aradin, a  Tiefling character): “That bastard broke his nose! What is this place?”
    • (Responding remark to any of leaders' punches): “Let's try to avoid any more punching - we need to find a healer.”
  • (Either Aradin or Zevlor was knocked out by avatar): “He'll feel that in the morning.”
    • (Responding remark to any of avatar’s punches): “Now that that's settled, we can get to finding a healer.”
  • (Reaction to non-lethal ending of Aradin/Zevlor conflict): “Those two must have history. ”
    • (Responding remark): “Yes. It's a good thing we were here.”
  • (Reaction to Zevlor’s words about more goblins): “You heard them. More goblins could be on their way.”
    • (Responding remark): “I'm more worried about this parasite than a few goblins. We need a healer.”
  • (Saw Aradin leaving the grove): “That could have been worse.”
    • (Responding remark): “For once.”
  • (Noticed the Strange Ox): “I'd swear that ox's gaze is following me.”
  • (Noticed a crevice that is actually an entrance to the Tiefling Hideout): “I can't fit through here. Wonder if there's another way in.”
    • (Trying to get through the crevice,  Gnome,  Halfling,  Dwarf,  Disguised or  Reduced character): “Tight fit. I barely got through.”
    • (Successfully squeezed through,  Gnome,  Halfling,  Dwarf,  Disguised or  Reduced character): “Tight fit. I won't be getting back in that way.”
  • (Saw their belongings in the Tieflings Hideout): “Wait. This looks familiar.”
  • (Let Arka shoot Sazza): “Sloppily done. But I guess the goblin had it coming.”
    • (Responding remark): “Won't shed tears over a goblin, but still - not a pretty scene.”
  • (After Sazza told the party about Priestess Gut): “A goblin healer? That's a new one. But she might be the only way to keep our skulls intact.”
  • (After Sazza told the party about Priestess Gut, a  Githyanki character): “The goblin knows nothing of the ghaik. This is a waste of time.”
  • (Responding remark): “She's worth talking to, at least.”
  • (Found Torchstalks behind the Grove's prison) "I don't like the look of that mushroom. I should stay clear."
  • (Helped Sazza escape from the grove): “That goblin is in my debt - should prove useful one day.”
    • (Responding remark): “Or it'll come back to haunt us.”
  • (Watching at the map in Zevlor’s cave): “Looks like we're in Elturgard. Some distance from the city of Baldur's Gate.”
  • (Watching at the map in Zevlor’s cave, a Baldurian[3] character): “Elturgard. Further from Baldur's Gate than I'd hoped.”
    • (Responding remark): “Gnolls and goblins marked on the map. Travel won't be easy.”


Sacred Pool and Inner Sanctum

  • (Trying to use the elevator blocked by a sleeping bear): “Won’t budge.”
  • (Trying to recognize the ritual chanted by druids): “That ritual. A common growth spell, but... altered, somehow.”
    • (Responding remark): “But nothing to worry about... right?”
    • (Responding remark, a Druid avatar): “And so many needed for the casting. Unusual.”
  • (If Arabella was killed by Teela during the trial): “The snake killed that girl in front of everyone. Is this grove worth a dead child?”
    • (Responding remark): “The longer we stay here, the closer we come to reaching the same fate.”
  • (Read Kagha’s recruitment letter from Shadow Druids, a Druid avatar): “Shadow Druids? Kagha means to turn the circle.”
  • (Read Kagha’s recruitment letter from Shadow Druids): “Shadow Druids? There's more to Kagha than meets the eye.”
    • (Responding remark): “It's time we had a talk with her, don't you think?”
    • (Responding remark, a Druid avatar): “The circle will fall into darkness if we don't intervene.”
    • (Read the letter before meeting Kagha): “Shadow Druids at work - and this Kagha is their newest recruit.”
    • (Read the letter before meeting Kagha, a Druid avatar): “Shadow Druids? This Kagha is not to be trusted.”
  • (In Halsin’s chamber, saw dead drow): “I wonder what happened to that drow.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “Is there a dead tadpole in that jar?”
    • (Responding remark 2): “And look at that statue.”
    • (Responding remark 3): “I can't tell if this is a temple or a library.”
  • (In Halsin’s chamber, saw dead drow, a Drow/Half-Drow avatar): “A dead drow. Hardly a welcoming sight.”
    • (Responding remark 1, a Drow/Half-Drow avatar): “Hardly a welcoming sight.”
    • (Responding remark 2&3, a Drow/Half-Drow avatar): “I'm still wondering about the dead drow.”
  • (Read Halsin’s research on tadpoles): “This 'Halsin' has been studying the tadpole.”
    • (Responding remark): “We should find him, maybe he can help?”
  • (Read Halsin’s research on tadpoles, knows druid’s missing): “Looks like Halsin's our best bet for a cure.”
    • (Responding remark 1): “We need to find him, before it's too late.”
    • (Responding remark 2): “What if something happened to him?”
    • (Responding remark 3): “All the more reason to hurry.”
    • (Responding remark 3, a Githyanki avatar): “Enough chatter. We retrieve Halsin, we find a cure.”
  • (Feeling sick after Nettie scratched them with a poisonous thorn): “I don't feel too good. What did that druid scratch me with?”
    • (Sickness getting worse after LR without cure): “The druid's poison is spreading. I need a cure, fast.”
    • (Almost dying after second LR without cure): “Argh, the poison. It's too much. It's too late...”
    • (Cured from Nettie’s poison): “I can feel the poison clearing - I'm cured!”
  • (Nettie locked the party up after they refused to take wyvern poison): “So much for honesty. Our healer turned into a jailor pretty quickly once she heard about the tadpole.”
    • (Responding remark): “Can't blame anyone for reacting with fear - but it might do to keep our condition on a need-to-know basis.”
  • (Agreed to take Wyvern poison from Nettie): “Wyvern poison. Let's hope it doesn't come to that.”
  • (Responding remark 1): “Better a quick draught than ceremorphosis, nonetheless.”
  • (Responding remark 2): “Better to have on hand than not.”
  • (Responding remark 3): “Hopefully we'll be rid of this parasite before we even need to think in that direction.”
  • (Near statue in the Underground Passage) "Glowing eyes are rarely a good sign. Best be careful."
  • (Opened the druids’ library with the magic circlet): “It's opened. I wonder what's back there.”
  • (Failed to open a stone door in druids’ cave from the passage without the magic circlet): “I can't even see a lock to pick.”
  • (Opened the secret stairs down with a Rune of the Wolf): “Well well, what have we here.”
  • (Saw a magic-imbued glaive in druids’ library, knows the story): “The glaive the druid's notebook mentioned. Its owner thought it was cursed...”
    • (Haven’t read about the weapon’s story): “A beautiful glaive. So why does touching it give me a knot in my stomach?”

* (Found an empty slot in a stone wall): “The stone's less worn here. Recently uncovered.”

    • (Found a slot in the wall, knows it’s for a stone rune): “A tidy slot, but no rune.”
  • (Found a broken rune among the ruins): “It's broken, but not too badly.” ??


  • (Approaching Secluded Cove, heard harpies): “Is someone... singing?”
    • (Responding remark): “It's beautiful...”
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 1) "These melodies..."
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 2)I could listen to this forever...
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 3)What beautiful music...
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 4)I could drown in that song...
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 5) "Come here... please!"
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 6)It's lovely...
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 7)I'll be there soon, my lady.
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 8)That song...
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 9) "Closer... I need to get closer!"
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 10)Take me with you!
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 11)Don't stop singing...
  • (Charmed by Harpy's song, 12)I've never heard something so beautiful...
  • (Broke the Harpy's charm, 1) "No... this isn't right..."
  • (Broke the Harpy's charm, 2) "What... what happened?"
  • (Broke the Harpy's charm, 3) "What... what was that?"
  • (Broke the Harpy's charm, 4) "Stay out of my head!"
  • (Found harpies’ nest, haven’t met Harpies): “A giant nest... let's see what we can find.”
  • (Found harpies’ nest, defeated Harpies): “Let's see what those harpies were hoarding.”

* (Found harpies’ nest, spoke with Mirkon): “Must be what that kid was talking about.”

  • (During the attack on the grove, can’t open the door to druid sanctum): “Locked from the inside.”
  • (Found dead tiefling children after the attack on the grove): “Butchered. They didn't stand a chance.”
  • (Found the vines all around the grove): “There's no getting through.”
  • (Found the vines all around the grove, a Druid avatar): “There's no getting past those vines. The ritual was thorough.”
  • (Found the vines all around the grove, a Ranger avatar): “A mouse couldn't squeeze through those vines.”
  • (Found the vines all around the grove, knows about Rite of Thorns): “Looks like the ritual worked. The whole grove is walled in.”
  • (Found the vines all around the grove, knows about Rite of Thorns, a Druid avatar): “To summon those vines... the power's impressive.”
  • (Found the vines all around the grove, knows about Rite of Thorns, a Ranger avatar): “There's a darkness coursing through those vines.”
  • (Found the vines all around the grove, knows about Rite of Thorns, a Tiefling avatar): “They wanted tieflings out. They got their wish.”
  • (Tried to attack the vines): “ It'd take an age to hack through all this.”
  • (Tried to attack the vines, a Druid avatar): “It's hopeless. Silvanus' will holds these vines in place.”
  • (Tried to attack the vines, a Ranger avatar): “The bark's like iron. This is a waste of time.”

Forest and Owlbear Nest

  • (Hearing Andrik and Brynna ahead): “People up ahead. Something's wrong...”
  • (Saw tracks leading into the cave, SUR check successful): “Owlbear tracks. Its nest must be nearby.”
    • (Failed): “Looks like a beast came through here - a big one too.”
  • (Entering the cave, saw tracks outside): “Whatever made those tracks seems to be in here...”
  • (Entering the cave, recognized tracks outside): “That stench... dead owlbear prey, no doubt.”
    • (Entering the cave, felt the stink, did not recognize the tracks): “Ugh! What is that? Rotting flesh?”
  • (Picked up the Owlbear Egg, did not recognize the tracks): “That's quite an egg.”
    • (Picked up the egg while in combat): “She'll tear me in two for touching her egg.”
    • (Picked up the egg after defeating Mother Owlbear): “An owlbear egg... these are supposed to be worth a fortune...”
  • (Spared the Owlbear Cub after killing its mother): “At least the cub has a fighting chance now.”
    • (Responding remark): “That, or we've just prolonged its misery.”
  • (Healed the Mother owlbear): “Healed - but she doesn't look much happier.”
  • (Found Mother Owlbear killed by goblins, after you’ve spared her): “Looks like the goblins found her.”
  • (Responding remark): “She deserved better than that.”
  • (Killed the Owlbear Cub): “It was for the best. The cub would've died anyway.”
    • (Responding remark): “Nature might've provided for it. Too late now.”
    • (Finding a shrine to Selûne, Religion check):
    • (Successful) "Looks like a shrine to Selûne over there."
    • (Failed) "Looks like there's a little shrine over there."
    • (Cleric of Selune) “Over there - a shrine to Selûne. By Moonmaiden's grace.”
  • (Near magically sealed chest) "There's magic keeping this chest sealed; I can feel its aura."
    • (Found a prayer, Investigation check succeed) “A prayer sheet. With the same symbol as the one on the chest.”
    • (Cleric of Selune) “Blessings from the Moonmaiden - and bearing the same symbol as that chest.”
    • (Failed) “A prayer sheet. What's this symbol on it?”
    • (Failed, a Selunite Cleric) “Moonmaiden's teachings. But why hidden back here? And what's this symbol?”
    • (Religion check failed) “Just an old prayer.”
    • (Religion check failed, Cleric of Selune) “Blessings of the Moonmaiden. Praise her.”
    • (Try to open without disarming magical seal): “Agh! This thing won't yield its contents easily...”
    • (Opened the chest) “If I knew praying could be useful, I would've started years ago.”
    • (Opened the chest, Cleric of Selune) “Moonmaiden's grace! It's open!”
  • (Picking up the Selûnite Rite) "Hmm. Selûnite coming-of-age rituals. Seems like a serious undertaking - dangerous, even."
    • (Cleric of Selune) “Ah, it speaks of the Moonmaiden's sacred rites of passage. I still remember my own.”
  • (Triggered a trap from the Ornate mirror) What in the hells - get back!


Sunlit Wetlands / Putrid Bog

  • (After helping Auntie Ethel against Demir and Johl) “Bloody way to end an argument. I hope we chose the right side.”
    • (Responding remark): “No point in debating what's already done. Let's go on ahead.”
  • (Found Demir and Johl dead, haven’t met them)': “Someone cut these men to pieces. I doubt they had time to scream. ”
    • (Found brothers, a Gith avatar): “Fools. Little surprise they perished.”
    • (Found brothers, a Duergar avatar): “Hmph. Humans. What did they expect?”
    • (Have encountered them arguing with Ethel): “The brothers? I guess they didn't find their sister.”
    • (Responding remark to either): “Be ready. Whoever - or whatever - did this could be close.”
  • (Finding carnage on the Sunlit Wetlands beach) "Looks like we missed all the fun."
    • (Investigation check, successful) “Redcaps, no doubt. Wasteful creatures.”
    • (Failed) “Whatever attacked them, you have to admire its gusto.”
  • (Noticed the knife-damaged tree bark in the Decrepit Sanctuary): “Odd - someone's cut a notch in the tree there.”
    • (Saw the damaged bark, knowing about Kagha’s letter): “Hm - must be the tree from the note to Kagha. What's that cleft there?”
  • (Found a sword and a helmet in the middle of the bog): “Sword and a hat. Wonder whose.”
  • (Tried to pick a fruit from a Barbed Bulrush, pricked a finger): “Ah! My finger.”
  • (After defeating Gandrel, stood to Astarion) "You protected a child-stealing vampire? Bold choice."
    • (Responding remark): “Let's hope it doesn't come back to bite me later.”
